First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: none too long or fast. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the The Second Sunday Ride group ride

A monthly adventure ride to a scenic, historic or cultural spot, mostly within an hour's drive of Auburn. Rides are short and slow enough for about anyone. The site's ride archive goes back to 2010. Check the site, since some months land on a Saturday.
